scope: Fairphone 6 (FP6) inputs: the commit of Fairphone's source manifest that the kernel imports and the device configuration follow, and the families that group the stock files selected in config/fp6-minimal/vendor-files.json (its inventory_ref values). The stock release is named in config/stock-inputs.json.

fairphone_manifest.source: The fairphone-manifest source in config/forks.json holds the URL and the followed branch, and reads this revision as its pin.

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: HIDL audio/effect interfaces, ALSA controls and AudioReach DSP protocol
userspace_hal_families.load_path: source-built service/libraries plus generated vendor blobs
userspace_hal_families.rebuilt_from_source: partial: the primary HAL, PAL, AGM and audioadsprpcd are built from source (DiamaneOS forks); the graph services, ACDB and configuration stay stock
userspace_hal_families.note: Fairphone's graphservices project holds only headers (gsl, acdb, ar_osal, spf); the graph service libraries are not published.

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: Android/Qualcomm Bluetooth HALs, bt-kernel transport and controller firmware
userspace_hal_families.load_path: generated vendor tree plus bluetooth partition

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: Camera provider/framework interfaces, Qualcomm camera UAPI and sensor/DSP firmware
Android telephony interfaces, Qualcomm QCRIL/QMI/IMS interfaces and modem protocol
userspace_hal_families.load_path: generated vendor tree and modem partition

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: fingerprint AIDL/HIDL contract, SPI/input kernel interfaces and trusted-app protocol
stable Gatekeeper/KeyMint interfaces, QSEE/SPU kernel APIs and trusted-app protocol
userspace_hal_families.load_path: generated vendor tree plus keymaster/tz/spu firmware partitions

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: GNSS AIDL, location libraries, QMI/modem and assistance-data protocols
userspace_hal_families.load_path: GNSS HAL service, IGnss implementation and location libraries built from CodeLinaro source (hardware/qcom/gps and vendor/qcom/opensource/location, DiamaneOS forks; libqti_vndfwk_detect_vendor from vendor/qcom/opensource/core-utils) with the QMI client of Qualcomm's public QMI framework (DiamaneOS fork) linked into libloc_api_v02, installed by device gnss/gnss.mk; Fairphone's stock gps.conf, izat.conf (pinned edits) and sap.conf from the generated vendor tree; the GNSS engine in the modem partition

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: graphics allocator/composer/mapper, media codec APIs and kernel DRM/KGSL/video UAPI
userspace_hal_families.load_path: source-built services plus generated vendor libraries/firmware

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: NFC AIDL/HIDL and the Samsung controller transport (sec_nfc); the UICC secure-element HAL stays with the radio selection
userspace_hal_families.load_path: generated vendor tree (stock android.hardware.nfc-service.sec, nfc_nci_sec.so and configuration); the frozen AOSP NFC interface libraries they link are built from source (renderer SOURCE_INTERFACES)

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: sensors multihal, sensor DSP interfaces and firmware
userspace_hal_families.load_path: generated vendor tree plus DSP firmware

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: Android Wi-Fi HAL/supplicant, nl80211/cfg80211 and QCA6750 firmware API
userspace_hal_families.load_path: system/vendor Wi-Fi services plus /vendor_dlkm modules and vendor firmware
userspace_hal_families.rebuilt_from_source: host stack and kernel portions only

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: The closed thermal engine complements the source thermal HAL with device thermal control. Qualcomm's perf2 performance backend and its client libraries are not selected; the source power HAL needs none.
userspace_hal_families.load_path: Explicit selected stock thermal-engine-v2 and its authenticated configuration/dependencies; no blanket auxiliary-package inclusion.

userspace_hal_families.abi_uapi: QRTR/QMI service registration, protection-domain mapping, peripheral (subsystem) management, remote storage and file-server protocols with the modem and DSPs
userspace_hal_families.load_path: linux-msm tqftpserv (DiamaneOS fork, libqrtr linked in), pd-mapper and libqrtr (DiamaneOS fork, installed as libqrtr_linux_msm.so) built from source (device modem/modem.mk, init.modem.rc and init.qcom.rc); Qualcomm's libqrtr.so, the peripheral manager, rmt_storage and ssr_setup from the generated vendor tree, started by the device init files and the stock rmt_storage init file

firmware_families.hash: per-image SHA-256 and size in config/fp6-firmware-inventory.json
firmware_families.abi_uapi: modem/QMI/IMS, Bluetooth controller, DSP RPC and CPU-control protocols
firmware_families.load_path: dedicated raw A/B partitions and firmware mount points
firmware_families.function: cellular, Bluetooth, audio/compute DSP and supporting controllers

firmware_families.hash: per-file SHA-256 and size in config/fp6-minimal/vendor-files.json
firmware_families.abi_uapi: controller-specific audio amplifier, haptics, touch, WLAN and other peripheral protocols

exact-stock-non-source.evidence: Generated inputs bind the declared stock build, region, source path, destination path and per-file hash.
exact-stock-non-source.validation: The generator rejects unexpected versions, hashes, missing files and unrelated substitutions.
